evidence.hard_stops_checked: Checked and clear: no pricing or offer change, no new factual business claim, no secrets or credentials touched, no deployment performed, no third-party service or backend added, no external outreach. No PII is transmitted to any new destination — the lead payload to /api/lead is unchanged and GA4 receives only lead_source and locale.
evidence.reviewer_ensemble: builder pass, skeptic pass, taste pass — see the reviewer_ensemble object for the evidence behind each verdict.
evidence.reviewer_disagreement_reviewed: The skeptic challenged whether firing on submit overstates conversions when the POST may fail. Resolved by reporting on success in daily-publish-prompt, the only form that awaits the response; the other four are fire-and-forget by existing design and were left consistent with it rather than restructured in an analytics PR.
evidence.winner_rationale: A tiny shared helper plus one call per form was chosen over extending the inline GA4 link handler, because that handler only sees anchor clicks and cannot observe a React form submission. Reusing the canonical LeadSource type from lib/lead-responder keeps one definition of what a lead source is.
evidence.tests_or_validation: pnpm check green: lint 0 errors with 3 pre-existing warnings in untouched files, typecheck clean, 212/212 tests across 36 files, production build passed. The new suite asserts the exact GA4 payload, absence of every PII key the forms collect, silent no-op when gtag is missing, that lead_source is registered as a custom dimension, and that every file POSTing to /api/lead also calls trackLeadSubmit.
